qualification: Source review and CPU conformance only; CUDA/model qualification remains required.
notes: Kraken-line composition of installer image sha256:d52737a109e0 (release 2026.10.2), reviewed against the connector-job API surface directly. It shares no reviewed commit with the jj (abb715f) or R27 (5dede5b) compositions, so every fingerprint below is independent.

Deferred block freeing: the scheduler returns freed blocks to the pool only after the in-flight step's writes complete (Scheduler._free_request_blocks, _free_cow_retained_blocks, _drain_deferred_frees; drained in update_from_output). This strengthens full-attention prefix immutability; SparkCache holds its own block-pool reference per source page, so delayed frees extend page lifetimes and never shorten them.

Extra scheduler bindings: bind_kv_cache_manager, boundary capture releaser, boundary checkpoint cache and the recurrent publication boundary provider are optional hooks the generic adapter never calls.

Async load deferral: pre_forward keeps start_load_kv for post_forward when has_sync_kv_loads is false. Load-path only; post_forward still calls wait_for_save after target and MTP state writes, and no_forward passes wait_for_save=False.
AsyncScheduler subclasses Scheduler and inherits every reviewed hook, so --async-scheduling compositions keep these semantics unchanged.
The encoder-cache connector (ec_connector) carries its own metadata channel and never touches KV block ownership.

The CSF layer of the image replaced vllm/envs.py. envs.py is not fingerprinted here and none of the lease semantics read it; SparkCache reads its capture settings from kv-transfer extra config and its own environment variables. The in-image parent-cache contract binds the pre-CSF envs.py bytes and therefore refuses this image; this contract rebinds to the image's actual bytes without weakening any check.
use_v2_model_runner defaults to false and the pinned model_runner.py is the runner that drives the connector callbacks.
